topic: on-board A/B: stale coefficients vs no model (silent source, v2, new layout)
method: silent source keeps the loop open with no excitation; 2 s per point; judged by microphone level, dominant frequency and single-mode energy share

conclusion.confirms_b: B's offline claim that the on-board coefficients are worse than no model is confirmed on hardware, and the effect is larger at the tested points
conclusion.note: with zero coefficients the boundary is about -2.5 dB, so reaching 0 dB digital gain is about 2.5 dB away rather than the 6 dB previously reported

caveat: silent source means no excitation; with live speech the boundary is lower. The earlier live-voice scan measured -12 dB stable and -10 dB marginal with the stale model, and must be repeated with zero coefficients and with B's new coefficients
next: listener judgement at the highest stable point
